reference.name: iter1-train-cut-dev
reference.source: autoresearch.trial --name base-iter1-dev, 2026-11-23, on the 1,120 development subjects (locked test set removed)
reference.features: iter10 recipe (Gordon+HCP tangent concat + age/sex + L2 logistic C=1e-2) + training-fold-only OOF cut (max ASD recall s.t. OOF control recall >= 73%), scored per subject (PR #19)
reference.note: All loop numbers are on the 1,120 development subjects. The 323 locked subjects (autoresearch/loop/holdout.py) are scored only by autoresearch.loop.final_holdout.

rule.note: ASD recall, either split (one split gains the margin, the other drops at most regress_tolerance), control recall >= floor on both. Every accepted step (+0.3pp vs the current base) becomes the new base AND opens a review PR, so every new best score can be reproduced from its own branch.

screen.rationale: Cheap filter on 6 mixed ABIDE I / II sites. The development base scores ASD recall 0.619 / control recall 0.803 here. 0.59 kills large regressions; control recall must also stay >= the floor.

loso-site.rationale: Must stay near the base site ASD recall before paying for the institution sweep; control recall above the floor.

loso-institution.rationale: Accept as the new base, and open a review PR, if site or institution ASD recall gains >= 0.003 vs the current base, the other split drops by at most 0.005, and control recall is >= the floor on both splits. Always report balanced accuracy, accuracy, AUC and both recalls.

floor.rationale: Control recall must stay >= 73% on every split: above every paper's control recall (Abraham 2017 72.3%, ASD-DiagNet 72.2%, BrainMass 71.9%, BrainNetTF 69.3%, Heinsfeld 2018 62%). With this floor, ASD recall above 74.3% (BrainMass, the best paper) beats every paper on both recalls.
